  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  May 15, 2021

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Himmelrich at 9:01 a.m.,
  on Saturday, May 15, 2021, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 at
  https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/kxqwqwqx

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Sue Himmelrich
  Mayor Pro Tem Kristin McCowan
  Councilmember Phil Brock arrived at 9:10 a.m.
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre arrived at 9:10 a.m.
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Christine Parra

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Lane Dilg
  Assistant City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 9:01 a.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers Brock and de la Torre.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 9:03 a.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 10:54 a.m., with all members present except
  Councilmembers Brock and de la Torre, to report the following:

  Mayor Himmelrich advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 10:54 a.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Sue Himmelrich
  Assistant City Clerk  Mayor
